findings.issue: `cohomF2`, and likewise `cohomF2Cup` (line 69) and `cohomF2One` (line 73), use nothing from the graded packaging: `cohomF2` is just the abbreviation for cohomology with `trivialF2` coefficients, `cohomF2Cup` is `(trivialF2TopPairing G).cup`, and `cohomF2One` the degree-zero class of the unit. Keeping them here forces any consumer of the abbreviation to import the whole Layer-12 cup stack (`Assoc`, `GradedComm`, `ProjectionFormula`, …).

findings.evidence: The proof uses only `TopRep.homogeneousCochains`, `homologyπ_surjective`, `iCycles_injective` and `trivialF2Equiv` — no cup declaration. Existing homes for such results: `ContCohomology/LowDegree.lean:707` `nsmul_H1_eq_zero`, `:773` `nsmul_H2_eq_zero`, and `ContCohomology/Torsion.lean:71` `exists_openSubgroup_index_nsmul_eq_zero` (which already has the homology API via its `Resolution`/`Additive` imports).
findings.fix: Move the all-degree exponent statement to `ContCohomology/Torsion.lean` (ideally in the general form "coefficients killed by `n` ⟹ every class killed by `n`", the all-degree analogue of the `H¹`/`H²` lemmas), and put the `trivialF2` specialization plus the `Module (ZMod 2) (cohomF2 G n)` instance in `ContCohomology/TrivialF2.lean`.
findings.issue: `resolutionX_two_nsmul` (line 86), `two_nsmul` (line 98) and `instModule` (line 240) are cup-product-free: they state that `H^n(G, 𝔽₂)` is killed by 2 and carry its canonical `ZMod 2`-module structure, which downstream mod-2 consumers want without the cup stack. `private` on the resolution lemma does not fix the home of the public ones.

summary: Imports are clean, but the file carries a generic name (`Cup/GradedAlgebra.lean`, beside the coefficient-agnostic `Cup/Graded.lean`/`Cup/GradedComm.lean`) while every declaration is `trivialF2`-specific, and three of its declarations depend on no cup theory and belong in earlier files.
